message.content:
Here's what turned up on Claude Code's code-review plugin, the slash commands, and related skills.

**Official code-review plugin (anthropics/claude-code repo)**
- The plugin's README explains how `/code-review` works. It checks if review is needed (skips closed, draft, trivial, or already-reviewed PRs), gathers relevant CLAUDE.md guideline files from the repository, and summarizes the pull request changes.
- It then launches 4 parallel agents to independently review: Agents #1 & #2 audit for CLAUDE.md compliance; Agent #3 scans for obvious bugs in changes; Agent #4 analyzes git blame/history for context-based issues.
- It scores each issue 0-100 for confidence level, filters out issues below 80 confidence threshold, and outputs review (to terminal by default, or as PR comment with --comment flag). You can change the threshold by modifying the command file at commands/code-review.md.
- Install it with `/plugin install code-review@claude-plugins-official`.

**Official docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review)**
- Running `/code-review` locally reviews your branch's commits ahead of its upstream plus any uncommitted changes, so it needs work on the branch or in the working tree to have something to report.
- On GitHub PRs, behavior changed in July 2026: before a July 2026 update, @claude review subscribed the PR to push-triggered reviews. If you relied on that behavior, comment @claude review always instead.

**Recent command reference (third-party, about 9 days old)**
- This guide lists the syntax as `/code-review [--fix] [--comment] [target]`: local diff review; --fix applies fixes; ultra runs cloud review. It also lists /simplify [target] (cleanup-only review, no bug hunt, v2.1.154+), /security-review (read-only security pass on branch diff), and /review [PR] (review a pull request locally).
- Its suggested order before a merge is /diff → /code-review → /security-review → /review.

**Skills context**
- A Claude Code skill is a SKILL.md file that gives the agent specialized instructions, context, and workflows for a specific task.
- Anthropic's official `simplify` skill reviews changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fixes what it finds.
- There are also community review skills, such as awesome-skills/code-review-skill, covering React 19, Vue 3, Rust, TypeScript, TanStack Query v5, and more.
- One source says before plugins existed (pre-October 2025) you had to configure Claude Code by hand.

**Things that don't match**
- The Claude Directory listing for the plugin shows code-review, review (quick review of staged changes), and review-file (deep review of a specific file). The official README only documents `/code-review`.
- The flags differ too. The official README documents only `--comment`. `--fix` and the "ultra" cloud review come from the third-party reference and may be newer. The official docs are the best place to confirm both.
